name: Azorius Senate
description: The Azorius Senate is the law-bound Ravnican guild of lawmages, arbiters and arresters, whose Senate House and symbol stand for law and order on Ravnica.

timeline.summary: In the mess hall Krenko overhears Boros soldiers saying the guild's succession has come down to a duel, found by the Azorius in the fine print.
timeline.quote: "No, the nosy Azorius found it in the fine print," he said.

citation.work: Krenko, Mob Boss
citation.text: "Krenko, Mob Boss" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2012.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals influential Azorius Senate members were petrified while he was away.
timeline.quote: a few influential members in the Azorius Senate were...eliminated.

citation.work: Homesick
citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains a planeswalking gorgon assassin with a grudge against the Azorius swore she would return.
timeline.quote: About a year ago, there was a gorgon assassin operating on Ravnica.

citation.work: Homesick
citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace of the Azorius's mass arrest of Golgari and her brutal imprisonment, her escape and her wish to lead the Golgari.
timeline.quote: They assumed I was Golgari because I was a gorgon, and they arrested me too.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the door bears the Azorius symbol that appears when they try to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: It's the symbol of the Azorius.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag goes into Zita's effigy shop, is heckled by an Azorius elocutor outside, and clumsily tries to chat her up.
timeline.quote: I'd like to buy these.

citation.work: The Illusions of Child's Play
citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag performs poetry and a comedy set mocking Azorius and Dovin Baan, which falls flat when an arrester appears.
timeline.quote: I finish my set anyway—twenty-three minutes of pure torture.

citation.work: The Illusions of Child's Play
citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: On the way home Zita fixes graffiti insulting Dovin Baan, and an Azorius arrester arrests her for defacing a building and slandering a Grand Arbiter, with Kodolaag's statement logged against her.
timeline.quote: defacing a public building," he continues, "Plus Azorius code 6342-P, slandering a Grand Arbiter," the arrester says, binding Zita up

citation.work: The Illusions of Child's Play
citation.text: "The Illusions of Child's Play" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jan 2019.

timeline.summary: A vedalken mugger steals one of Reza's satchels, and when Reza seeks help at the edge of the Thinktank, Azorius arresters suspect him instead.
timeline.quote: He swipes at the strap of one of my satchels. It comes free, and then he's running off with my precious reference texts.

citation.work: The Ascension of Reza
citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Missing his identity rune, Reza throws a vial of cleansing oil at the arresters and flees, fearing arrest under his own new law.
timeline.quote: I retrieve it from the satchel, then throw it down at the arrester's feet.

citation.work: The Ascension of Reza
citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: A huge electrical elemental emerges from a rift over the Thinktank workshop, and Azorius archons cannot act because of the jurisdiction dispute.
timeline.quote: More lightning lashes out of the rift as the elemental starts to take on a distinct form

citation.work: The Ascension of Reza
citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Azorius archons and nullmages subdue the elemental after Reza's law rune brings help.
timeline.quote: They work together to cast a blue dome of magic over the elemental

citation.work: The Ascension of Reza
citation.text: "The Ascension of Reza" by Nicky Drayden. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Feb 2019.

timeline.summary: Vraska rides a Realmbreaker branch down over Ravnica as general for Elesh Norn and has it plunge through the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: I choose the simplest one and order a branch to dive straight through its center.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Vraska at seventeen is held by an Azorius guard, and Ludmilla is killed while calling to her fellow Golgari prisoners.
timeline.quote: And then, with a wet slice and a heavy thump, she was not. I was the only gorgon left.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vraska has Phyrexian agents blind the Azorius and Boros guards, and orders the blinded forced to the Transguild Promenade as an example.
timeline.quote: "Lead them to the Transguild Promenade as an example of what we do to the unjust."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ravnica: One and the Same
